ANNA'S CAFE LARA PERFECT VENUE
Jul 2025 • Solo
From the instant you walk into Anna’s Café in Lara, there is the enticing aroma of freshly brewed coffee and a gracious and warm welcome from the owner Anna where everyone is greeted with a friendly hello and most by name such is the remarkable Anna’s memory. This amazing café combines country hospitality with an excellent cuisine prepared by Anna’s husband Ray and his pumpkin soup is second to none and also try the 3 stack pancakes – no one makes better. Notwithstanding the brilliance of the menu, I feel what genuinely sets Anna’s Café apart from so many others is the staff. Anna and her team go way beyond what is expected to make everyone who comes in feel like family. Whether you’re a local or just passing through, there’s a genuine friendliness that’s hard to find elsewhere or just manufacture. In this exceptional regional village of Lara, it is more than just a place to eat it’s like all good villages, it’s a place to catch up and share stories with friends of just read the newspaper. I would add that Anna truly is a remarkable person who shows a great love of the community in which she works and a genuine desire to make everyone feel welcome. For me a visit to Anna’s Café always leaves me smiling. Highly recommended! Gareth McCray OAM

Lives Up To The Reputation
Sep 2024 • Friends
I was drawn to this cafe after reading all the positive reviews left by other travelers, and it did not disappoint. Despite only being a 10-minute car ride from Da Lat's busy center, it feels like a distant overlook amongst the mountains, with a view of the city.

Peaceful, serene, and every corner of this place felt well-cared for and thought out. And for far-flung travelers missing a taste of home, the Western food served here tastes authentic and fulfilling.

In Da Lat's wide ocean of cafes and coffee shops, this place truly stands out.

A photographer's delight
Dec 2024 • Solo
Beautiful scenic environment. Right next to the cable cars. Outdoor/indoor cafe, adorned with flowers and plants, a photographers delight. I've had many meals here, though mostly breakfast. Everything I've eaten has been very good. My favorite breakfast meal, is the Rancheros Huevos, though their waffles, eggs, omelettes, are excellent as well. One of the attractions besides the tasty culinary delights, is the location, as the outdoor part of the cafe sits on the edge of a beautiful green lush valley, where photographers just love. The staff are very friendly and conscientious. This is a cafe that I will continue to visit. Coming there, is the highlight of my day. Thank you to both Anna and her husband, Bartlett, for setting up the guests for a beautiful experience.
